Plan

Steps F1, F2, … in order. Outbound: zig-zag from M0 to the last mainnet milestone on one L_diff plane, first EB txs, then Plutus steps. Return: directly back through the mainnet milestones at the surface plus the margin, rounded up to 0.1 s, using the current model settings.

Changes are not saved yet.

Needs: minimum L_diff from the model. With L_vote = L_diff − 3·L_hdr, the certification gate is W = 3·L_hdr + L_vote + L_diff = 2·L_diff. Opportunity = exp(−f·W) with f = 0.05 per second.

Derived protocol parameters

L_hdr fixed; L_vote = L_diff − 3·L_hdr. EB references = EB txs × 40/260. Plutus memory = Plutus steps × 0.0036. Reference scripts = 20 kB per G steps (4 MB at 200G). Bold: leading values.

Model: DeltaQ

Needs is the smallest L_diff with P(C) ≥ target at t_v = 3·L_hdr + L_vote = L_diff, and F_full|C ≥ target at W = 2·L_diff. Sampled from the conditional certification diffusion model (analysis.py on that branch): voter law G = EB references (multi-hop) ⊗ missing txs (1 hop, π1 = 1/6) ⊗ validation CPU; reapply-only law for the all-nodes term; top-stake committee of the configured seat count (900: coverage ≈ 98.84%) over a synthetic 2,500-node stake distribution, Normal approximation. “Plan limit” (default) fetches EB references at the plan’s limit, EB txs × 40/260. “Report’s mix” keeps the model’s fixed 1/64/256/512 kB body for every size and reproduces the report’s tables to within 0.05 s. Voters additionally spend c · steps · f_exec on Plutus execution. Node timings are treated as independent.
